sentences.en: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
Because the entrance was locked, we couldn't enter the house.
sentences.zh: 因为门锁着，我们无法进入房子。

sentences.en: I hope that my sister will pass the entrance examination.
sentences.zh: 我希望我的妹妹能通过入学考试。

senses.zh: 入口，门口；进入，入场；入学，录取；入场权，进入的机会；开始，着手
